events.description:
Called with Cloudflare's error code when the challenge fails (a refused visitor, a network error); the form then
has no token, so the server refuses the post.
events.name: onError

props.description: The name the token is posted under; Cloudflare's own `cf-turnstile-response` when left out.
props.name: name

props.description: The site key; the app's `VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` when left out.
props.name: siteKey
